methods: read-only local assessment of a public candidate repo
tasks.acceptance_gate: A written assessment with per-property grades, evidence links, and every place the rubric didn't fit, kept local and submitted to this repo only.

allowed_variations: any project shape except a single scalar bound

tracks.useful_outcome: Assessment cheap and repeatable enough to run weekly.

tasks.question: Can the orientation probe run as one command with a pinned model, budget and transcript?
tasks.acceptance_gate: A command that runs the probe against a repo at a pinned commit and saves answers and transcript; tests pass.
tasks.bottleneck_link: Without tooling every assessment is hand work.

tasks.question: What should an assessment record contain so hubs can exchange and compare them?
tasks.acceptance_gate: A schema in spec/schemas and the integer-mult-bounds smoke test rewritten in it; tests pass.
tasks.bottleneck_link: Hubs exchange assessments by file format.

tracks.useful_outcome: Independent reruns that confirm or contradict existing grades.

tasks.question: Does an independent orientation probe on the same commit give the same answers?
methods: rerun the probe at the recorded commit
tasks.acceptance_gate: A comparison naming each disagreement, with the commit and model used.
tasks.bottleneck_link: Probe reliability is an open question the grades depend on.

tracks.useful_outcome: Spec changes justified by assessment evidence.

tasks.question: Are the duplicate-rate and response-time thresholds in §3.2 sensible?
methods: measure listed projects in a 14-day window
tasks.acceptance_gate: A proposed change to §3.2 backed by measurements from at least two projects.

tracks.useful_outcome: Listings that help people choose on human terms.

tasks.question: Which listing signals help a non-expert choose a project without becoming a popularity ranking?
tasks.acceptance_gate: A site change showing the chosen signals, with a note on why each helps choosing.
tasks.bottleneck_link: People choose projects; the gallery is the main surface.
